senses.gloss: m. (v. Rashi to Nah. III, 6) = רְעִי II, excrement, discharge from the bowels. Sifra M’tsorʿa, Zabim, Par. 1; Makhsh. VI, 7.—[Sabb. XX, 4 (140ᵇ) מפני הר׳, Mish. Nap. a. Pes., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90, v. רְעִי I.]—בית ר׳ digestive organ, crop, maw. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., Par. 7, ch. IX מה אם … את בית הר׳ וכ׳ where the Scripture permits the use of the digestive organ (the maw of ruminants) &c.; כאן שפסל בית הר׳ וכ׳ here (in the case of fowls) where the Scripture rejects the digestive organ (the crop) &c.—[Kel. XVII, 2 בית הר׳ ed. Dehr., v. רְעִי II.]
